about.title: About
about.summary: Hi, I'm James, a Frontend & Full Stack Developer from Heredia, Costa Rica. Since August 2024 I've worked freelance and delivered 10+ client projects in real estate, corporate and e-commerce with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js and Strapi. I care about fast, SEO-friendly sites that are easy to maintain. I speak Spanish (native) and English (B2), and I'm open to remote, hybrid or on-site roles.

faq.title: Recruiter FAQ
faq.intro: Quick answers about role, stack, availability and contact.

items.a: I'm a Frontend & Full Stack Developer. Since August 2024 I've worked freelance, building websites and web apps for real estate, corporate and e-commerce clients.

items.q: Which technologies do you work with?
items.a: Next.js, React, TypeScript and Node.js are my main stack, with Strapi as headless CMS, Tailwind CSS, REST and GraphQL APIs, plus Shopify and WordPress customization.

items.q: Are you open to remote work?
items.a: Yes. I'm open to remote, hybrid or on-site roles.

items.q: Where are you based and which time zone do you work in?
items.a: I live in Heredia, Costa Rica, in the Central America time zone (UTC-6, no daylight saving time).

items.q: How can I contact you or get your CV?
items.a: Email me at jjguevarag@gmail.com, message me on LinkedIn or GitHub, or download my CV as a PDF from the top of this page.
